semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Cathay Pacific Airways provides logistics services that are crucial for the transportation of semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
summary: Cathay Pacific Airways, through its Cathay Cargo division, specializes in air cargo logistics, including the transportation of specialized cargo such as semiconductor manufacturing equipment. They offer tailored solutions for sensitive items, ensuring safe and efficient delivery.
capabilities: Scheduled air cargo services to major cities worldwide

regional_presence.Japan: Cathay Cargo operates more than 10 cargo flights per week from Narita and Kansai airports, connecting Japan to its global network.
